newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeitler - Buba backs Bonn on call for strong mark.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler - Buba backs Bonn on call for strong mark.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Tuesday that the Bundesbank shared the Bonn government's support for a strong mark and he believed the mark's correction against other key currencies was over.

Zeitler also said the German central bank would carefully watch developments in M3 money supply, a key Bundesbank indicator, in the coming months in light of the German share market recently soaring to record highs.

Asked to comment on German Finance Minister Theo Waigel's assertion earlier on Tuesday that the dollar and sterling's rise against the mark constituted an overreaction, Zeitler said: "I have already said that the mark correction ought to be finished. The Bundesbank and the government are still interested in a strong mark."
Zeitler said the recent gains in the German share market, as well as in German debt markets, could indicate a positive message for economic recovery to come.

"The other question is what is the driving force. Here it will be important in the coming months to watch developments in M3, which remains an important guiding point for the Bundesbank," Zeitler said.
